import argparse
import faulthandler
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PUBLIC = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06/probes/history_lock_variability.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("variability_public_probe", PUBLIC)
public = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(public)


def delegated_worker(source, folder_name, variant, profile, worker_id, barrier, counter, states):
    folder = Path(folder_name)
    with (folder / f"worker-{worker_id}.stack.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stack:
        faulthandler.enable(file=stack)
        period = profile.get("dump_period_seconds", 8)
        if period:
            faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(period, repeat=True, file=stack)
        public.set_phase(states, worker_id, "starting", -1)
        try:
            public.worker_operations(source, folder, variant, profile, worker_id, barrier, counter, states)
        except BaseException:
            public.write_json(folder / f"worker-{worker_id}-fatal.json", {"traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
            raise
        finally:
            if period:
                faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("label")
    parser.add_argument("variant")
    parser.add_argument("profile_json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    public.worker = delegated_worker
    result = public.trial(args.output, args.source, args.variant, json.loads(args.profile_json), args.label)
    raise SystemExit(0 if result["protocol_completed"] else 1)

import ctypes
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata as metadata
import json
import os
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import winreg
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import psutil

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROBES = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06/probes"


def now():
    return datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()


def write(path, data):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def hashes():
    paths = [p for folder in (ROOT / "src", ROOT / "tests/v3") for p in folder.rglob("*.py")]
    paths.append(ROOT / "pyproject.toml")
    return {p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}


def snapshot(label):
    security_command = r'''
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$sys = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$security = @(Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/SecurityCenter2 -ClassName AntiVirusProduct |
    Select-Object displayName, productState)
$processes = @(Get-Process -Name cis,cmdagent -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProcessName, Id)
$drivers = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_SystemDriver | Where-Object { $_.Name -in
    @('cmdguard','cmdhlp','cmderd','cmdvirth','inspect','cfrmd','cmdcss') } | Select-Object Name, State)
[ordered]@{observed_at=(Get-Date).ToString('o');boot_time=$sys.LastBootUpTime.ToString('o');
    security_products=$security;comodo_processes=$processes;selected_comodo_driver_registrations=$drivers;
    guard64_file_exists=(Test-Path -LiteralPath 'C:/Windows/System32/guard64.dll')} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
'''
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command", security_command])
    security = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    with winreg.OpenKey(winreg.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, r"SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion") as key:
        windows = {name: winreg.QueryValueEx(key, name)[0] for name in
                   ("EditionID", "DisplayVersion", "CurrentBuildNumber", "UBR")}
    kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
    kernel.GetModuleHandleW.argtypes = [ctypes.c_wchar_p]
    kernel.GetModuleHandleW.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    packages = ("pytest", "pytest-cov", "pytest-asyncio", "pytest-mock", "httpx", "anyio", "ruff", "mypy", "psutil")
    data = {"observed_at": now(), "security": security, "windows": windows, "python": sys.version,
            "executable": sys.executable, "platform": platform.platform(),
            "packages": {name: metadata.version(name) for name in packages},
            "guard64_loaded": bool(kernel.GetModuleHandleW("guard64.dll")),
            "pytest_entrypoints": [{"name": ep.name, "value": ep.value}
                                   for ep in metadata.entry_points(group="pytest11")],
            "source_sha256": hashes()}
    write(OUT / f"environment-{label}.json", data)
    return data


def run(command, label, timeout):
    started = time.monotonic()
    record = {"phase": label, "command": command, "started_at": now()}
    write(OUT / "phase.json", record)
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    with (OUT / f"{label}.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ), stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        timed_out = False
        try:
            code = process.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            children = psutil.Process(process.pid).children(recursive=True)
            for child in children:
                try:
                    child.terminate()
                except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
                    pass
            _, alive = psutil.wait_procs(children, timeout=5)
            for child in alive:
                try:
                    child.kill()
                except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
                    pass
            process.terminate()
            code = process.wait(timeout=10)
    record.update({"finished_at": now(), "seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
                   "exitcode": code, "timed_out": timed_out})
    write(OUT / f"{label}-execution.json", record)
    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
    return record


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--snapshot-only":
        snapshot(sys.argv[2])
        raise SystemExit(0)
    before = snapshot("before")
    write(OUT / "commit.json", {"commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT,
                                                                 text=True).strip()})
    executions = []
    matrix = run([sys.executable, str(PROBES / "history_lock_variability.py"), str(OUT / "matrix-01"),
                  "--repeats", "3", "--control-rounds", "2000"], "matrix", 2700)
    executions.append(matrix)
    for iteration in range(1, 11):
        label = f"history-{iteration:02}"
        executions.append(run([sys.executable, str(PROBES / "history_process_stacks.py"), str(OUT / label)], label, 180))
        write(OUT / "executions.json", executions)
    after = snapshot("after")
    assert before["source_sha256"] == after["source_sha256"]
    write(OUT / "executions.json", executions)
    print(json.dumps({"finished": now(), "source_unchanged": True,
                      "failed_executions": sum(r["exitcode"] != 0 for r in executions)}), flush=True)

import argparse
import faulthandler
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PUBLIC = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06/probes/history_lock_variability.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("variability_public_probe", PUBLIC)
public = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(public)


def delegated_worker(source, folder_name, variant, profile, worker_id, barrier, counter, states):
    folder = Path(folder_name)
    with (folder / f"worker-{worker_id}.stack.txt").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as stack:
        faulthandler.enable(file=stack)
        period = profile.get("dump_period_seconds", 8)
        if period:
            faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(period, repeat=True, file=stack)
        public.set_phase(states, worker_id, "starting", -1)
        try:
            public.worker_operations(source, folder, variant, profile, worker_id, barrier, counter, states)
        except BaseException:
            public.write_json(folder / f"worker-{worker_id}-fatal.json", {"traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
            raise
        finally:
            if period:
                faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("output", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("label")
    parser.add_argument("variant")
    parser.add_argument("profile_json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    public.worker = delegated_worker
    result = public.trial(args.output, args.source, args.variant, json.loads(args.profile_json), args.label)
    raise SystemExit(0 if result["protocol_completed"] else 1)

import importlib.util
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("observation_driver", OUT / "run_observation.py")
driver = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(driver)
probe_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("public_profiles", driver.PROBES / "history_lock_variability.py")
public = importlib.util.module_from_spec(probe_spec)
probe_spec.loader.exec_module(public)


def run_case(output, source, label, variant, profile):
    result = driver.run([driver.sys.executable, str(OUT / "case_entry.py"), str(output), str(source), label,
                         variant, json.dumps(profile)], label, 240)
    summary = output / label / "summary.json"
    observation = json.loads(summary.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if summary.exists() else {
        "label": label, "profile": profile, "variant": variant, "protocol_completed": False,
        "statistics_available": False, "parent_harness_interrupted": True,
        "workers": [], "rounds": None, "counter": None, "process_exitcodes": [],
        "successful_operations": 0, "errors": 0, "errors_by_kind": {}, "long_pending_events": [],
        "seconds": result["seconds"], "planned_attempts": profile["rounds"] * profile["workers"],
        "started_at": result["started_at"], "finished_at": result["finished_at"],
        "final_states": [],
        "stacks": {p.name: p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in (output / label).glob("*.stack.txt")},
        "timeout_reason": "Owned case supervisor exceeded 240 seconds; not classified as product open stall",
    }
    return {"execution": result, "observation": observation}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 900
    while not (OUT / "environment-after.json").exists():
        if time.monotonic() > deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("main driver's history tests did not finish")
        time.sleep(2)
    driver.snapshot("corrected-after-main")
    output = OUT / "matrix-02"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    evidence = {"change": "Same public trial in a fresh supervisor with a 240 second owned-process watchdog",
                "trials": []}
    isolated = OUT / "matrix-01/no-initialization-source/src"
    for name in ("burst", "short", "long"):
        profile = dict(next(p for p in public.PROFILES if p["name"] == name))
        variants = ("no-initialization",) if name == "burst" else ("current", "no-initialization")
        for variant in variants:
            label = f"repeat-03-{name}-{variant}"
            source = ROOT / "src" if variant == "current" else isolated
            evidence["trials"].append(run_case(output, source, label, variant, profile))
            driver.write(output / "evidence.json", evidence)
    for control in public.CONTROLS:
        profile = {"name": control["name"], "rounds": 2000, "workers": 3, "hold": 0.0,
                   "lifecycle": control["lifecycle"], "barrier": 60}
        label = f"repeat-03-{control['name']}"
        evidence["trials"].append(run_case(output, ROOT / "src", label, control["variant"], profile))
        driver.write(output / "evidence.json", evidence)
    driver.snapshot("corrected-before-dump-control")
    output = OUT / "dump-control-01"
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    supplement = {"probe_sha256": public.digest(driver.PROBES / "history_lock_variability.py"), "trials": [],
                  "change": "Periodic traceback dumps at 8 seconds or disabled; fatal handler enabled in both"}
    for repetition in (1, 2):
        for period in ((8, 0) if repetition % 2 else (0, 8)):
            profile = dict(next(p for p in public.PROFILES if p["name"] == "burst"))
            profile["dump_period_seconds"] = period
            label = f"repeat-{repetition:02}-dump-{period}"
            supplement["trials"].append(run_case(output, ROOT / "src", label, "current", profile))
            driver.write(output / "evidence.json", supplement)
    driver.snapshot("corrected-after")
    print(json.dumps({"remaining_finished": True, "supplement_finished": True}), flush=True)

import csv
import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DOCS = ROOT / "docs/investigations/quality-security-review-2026-10-06"


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def aggregate_trial(trial):
    workers = trial["workers"]
    opens = sum(w["open_latency"]["count"] for w in workers)
    return {
        "label": trial["label"], "profile": trial["profile"]["name"], "variant": trial["variant"],
        "statistics_scope": "complete" if trial["protocol_completed"] else (
            "surviving_workers_only" if workers else "missing"),
        "rounds": trial["rounds"], "workers": trial["profile"]["workers"],
        "hold_seconds": trial["profile"]["hold"], "lifecycle": trial["profile"]["lifecycle"],
        "barrier_seconds": trial["profile"]["barrier"], "seconds": trial["seconds"],
        "planned_attempts": trial["planned_attempts"], "observed_open_calls": opens,
        "successful_operations": trial["successful_operations"] if workers else None,
        "errors": trial["errors"] if workers else None,
        "missing_worker_results": trial["profile"]["workers"] - len(workers),
        "counter": trial["counter"],
        "errors_by_kind": trial["errors_by_kind"], "protocol_completed": trial["protocol_completed"],
        "max_open_seconds": max((w["open_latency"]["max_seconds"] or 0 for w in workers), default=None),
        "mean_open_seconds": (sum(w["open_latency"]["mean_seconds"] * w["open_latency"]["count"]
                                 for w in workers if w["open_latency"]["count"]) / opens if opens else None),
        "open_counts_at_least_seconds": {
            str(t): sum(w["open_latency"]["counts_at_least_seconds"][str(t)] for w in workers)
            for t in (0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 2.0)},
        "pending_open_events": (sum(e["phase"] == "open" for e in trial["long_pending_events"])
                                if trial.get("long_pending_events_available", True) else None),
        "pending_initialization_events": (sum(e["phase"] == "initialization" for e in trial["long_pending_events"])
                                          if trial.get("long_pending_events_available", True) else None),
        "starting_events": [e for e in trial["long_pending_events"] if e["phase"] == "starting"],
        "started_at": trial["started_at"], "finished_at": trial["finished_at"],
    }


def group_rows(rows):
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[(row["profile"], row["variant"])].append(row)
    summaries = []
    for (profile, variant), observations in groups.items():
        observations.sort(key=lambda r: r["label"])
        summaries.append({
            "profile": profile, "variant": variant, "trials": len(observations),
            "complete_trials": sum(r["protocol_completed"] for r in observations),
            "incomplete_executions": [r["label"] for r in observations if not r["protocol_completed"]],
            "complete_trial_attempts": sum(r["planned_attempts"] for r in observations if r["protocol_completed"]),
            "open_calls": sum(r["observed_open_calls"] for r in observations),
            "errors_by_execution": [r["errors"] for r in observations],
            "seconds_by_execution": [r["seconds"] for r in observations],
            "open_max_seconds_by_execution": [r["max_open_seconds"] for r in observations],
            "open_ge_10ms_by_execution": [r["open_counts_at_least_seconds"]["0.01"] for r in observations],
            "max_open_seconds": max((r["max_open_seconds"] for r in observations
                                     if r["max_open_seconds"] is not None), default=None),
            "min_trial_seconds": min(r["seconds"] for r in observations),
            "max_trial_seconds": max(r["seconds"] for r in observations),
            "mean_trial_seconds": statistics.fmean(r["seconds"] for r in observations),
        })
    return summaries


def main():
    before = read(OUT / "environment-corrected-before.json")
    after = read(OUT / "environment-corrected-after.json")
    initial = read(OUT / "environment-before.json")
    initial_matrix = read(OUT / "matrix-01/evidence.json")
    resumed_matrix = read(OUT / "matrix-02/evidence.json")
    abort = read(OUT / "owned-abort.json")
    missing_folder = OUT / "matrix-01/repeat-03-burst-current"
    start = next(json.loads(line) for line in (OUT / "matrix.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                 if line.startswith('{"started": "repeat-03-burst-current"'))
    profile = start["profile"]
    missing = {"label": "repeat-03-burst-current", "profile": profile, "variant": "current",
               "protocol_completed": False, "statistics_available": False, "parent_harness_interrupted": True,
               "workers": [], "rounds": None, "counter": None, "process_exitcodes": [],
               "successful_operations": 0, "errors": 0, "errors_by_kind": {}, "long_pending_events": [],
               "long_pending_events_available": False,
               "seconds": (datetime.fromisoformat(abort["at"]) - datetime.fromisoformat(start["at"])).total_seconds(),
               "seconds_scope": "Elapsed until manual abort, not a completed trial's processing time",
               "planned_attempts": profile["rounds"] * profile["workers"],
               "started_at": start["at"], "finished_at": abort["at"], "final_states": [],
               "stacks": {p.name: p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in missing_folder.glob("*.stack.txt")},
               "cause": "Multiple access violation reports followed by probe barrier notification wait; native fault location unknown"}
    matrix = {"trials": initial_matrix["trials"] + [missing] + [r["observation"] for r in resumed_matrix["trials"]],
